scope: Chinese wording reviewed; historical attribution only where a source-linked note is provided.

records.source: "All men are created equal" - Thomas Jefferson
records.zh: “人人生而平等。”——托马斯·杰斐逊

records.source: "All the Way with LBJ!"
records.zh: “约翰逊，一路支持到底！”

records.source: "Those who make peaceful revolution impossible, make violent revolution inevitable" - John Kennedy
records.zh: “让和平革命成为不可能的人，会使暴力革命成为必然。”——约翰·肯尼迪

records.source: "I'm Gerald Ford, and you're not."
records.zh: “我是杰拉尔德·福特，而你不是。”

records.source: "Fool me once, shame on  -  shame on you. Fool me  -  you can't get fooled again." - George W. Bush
records.zh: “骗我一次，丢脸的是……是你。再骗我……不能再上当了。”——乔治·W.·布什

records.source: "It's the economy stupid!"
records.zh: “关键是经济，笨蛋！”

records.source: "You shall not crucify mankind upon a cross of gold." - William Jennings Bryan
records.zh: “你们不能把人类钉在黄金的十字架上。”——威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩

records.source: "Politics have no relations to morals." - Machiavelli
records.zh: “政治与道德无关。”——马基雅维利

records.source: "I am not going to exploit, for political purposes, my opponent's youth and inexperience." - Ronald Reagan
records.zh: “我不会出于政治目的，拿对手的年轻和经验不足做文章。”——罗纳德·里根

records.source: "There are weapons of mass destruction in Iraq." - George W. Bush
records.zh: “伊拉克有大规模杀伤性武器。”——乔治·W·布什

records.source: "That was really uncalled for, Senator." - Dan Quayle
records.zh: “参议员，这话实在没有必要。”——丹·奎尔

records.source: "My failures have been error in judgement, not intent." - Ulysses S. Grant
records.zh: “我的失误在于判断，并非蓄意为之。”——尤利西斯·S.·格兰特

records.source: "When the president does it, that means it is not illegal" - Richard Nixon
records.zh: “总统做了，就说明这事不违法。”——理查德·尼克松

records.source: "Leave nothing for tomorrow which can be done today" - Abraham Lincoln
records.zh: “今天能做的事，不要留到明天。”——亚伯拉罕·林肯

records.source: "Extremism, in the defense of liberty, is no vice." - Barry Goldwater
records.zh: “为捍卫自由而采取极端立场，并非恶行。”——巴里·戈德华特

records.source: "I've signed legislation that will outlaw Russia forever. We begin bombing in five minutes." - Ronald Reagan
records.zh: “我已签署法令，永久取缔俄罗斯。五分钟后开始轰炸。”——罗纳德·里根

records.source: "Injustice anywhere, is a threat to justice everywhere." - Martin Luther King
records.zh: “任何地方的不公，都会威胁所有地方的正义。”——马丁·路德·金

records.source: "The Dream shall never die!" - Ted Kennedy
records.zh: “梦想永不消逝！”——爱德华·肯尼迪

records.source: "I have binders full of women!" - Mitt Romney
records.zh: “我有满满几文件夹的女性！”——米特·罗姆尼

records.source: "Who am I? Why am I here?" - James Stockdale
records.zh: “我是谁？我为什么在这里？”——詹姆斯·斯托克代尔

records.source: "Read My Lips: No New Taxes." - George HW. Bush
records.zh: “听清楚了：不增新税。”——乔治·H.·W.·布什

records.source: "Thomas Jefferson lives." - John Adams
records.zh: “托马斯·杰斐逊还活着。”——约翰·亚当斯

records.source: "Tippecanoe and Tyler Too!"
records.zh: “蒂皮卡努，还有泰勒！”

records.source: "There is no Soviet domination of eastern Europe!" - Gerald Ford
records.zh: “苏联没有控制东欧！”——杰拉尔德·福特

records.source: "Change based on principle is progress. Constant change without principle becomes chaos." - Dwight Eisenhower
records.zh: “基于原则的改变是进步，没有原则的不断改变会成为混乱。”——德怀特·艾森豪威尔

records.source: "Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction."" - Ronald Reagan
records.zh: “自由离消亡，永远只有一代人的距离。”——罗纳德·里根

records.source: "Ladies and gentlemen, I don't know whether you fully understand that I have just been shot," - Theodore Roosevelt
records.zh: “女士们、先生们，我不知道你们是否完全明白，我刚刚中了枪。”——西奥多·罗斯福

records.source: "DEWEY DEFEATS TRUMAN"
records.zh: “杜威击败杜鲁门”

records.source: "Hell no, we won't go!"
records.zh: “去他妈的，我们不去！”

records.source: "Hey, hey, LBJ, how many kids did you kill today?"
records.zh: “嘿，约翰逊，你今天害死了多少孩子？”

records.source: "Vote for the Crook: It’s Important!
records.zh: “投给那个贪腐的家伙，这很重要！”

records.source: "Every man a king, but no one wears a crown!"
records.zh: “人人皆国王，却无人戴王冠！”

records.source: "Keep cool with Coolidge!"
records.zh: “与柯立芝一起保持冷静！”

records.source: "Don't swap horses in the middle of the stream."
records.zh: “渡河中途不要换马。”

records.source: "Mr. Gorbachev, tear down this wall!" - Ronald Reagan
records.zh: “戈尔巴乔夫先生，拆掉这堵墙！”——罗纳德·里根

records.source: "Pokémon Go to the Polls!" - Hillary Clinton
records.zh: “让宝可梦‘GO’，去投票！”——希拉里·克林顿

records.source: "The only thing we have to fear is fear itself." - Franklin Roosevelt
records.zh: “我们唯一需要恐惧的，就是恐惧本身。”——富兰克林·罗斯福

records.source: "Only those who have the courage to fail greatly achieve greatly." - Robert Kennedy
records.zh: “只有敢于承受巨大失败的人，才能取得巨大成就。”——罗伯特·肯尼迪

records.source: "Amnesty, acid, and abortion."
records.zh: “赦免、迷幻药与堕胎。”

records.source: "In your heart, you know he's right!"
records.zh: “你心里明白，他是对的！”

records.source: "Give me liberty, or give me death!" - Patrick Henry
records.zh: “不自由，毋宁死！”——帕特里克·亨利

records.source: "Vote for Taft now, you can vote for Bryan anytime!"
records.zh: “这次先投塔夫脱，布赖恩哪次都能投！”

records.source: "Vote for the crook. It's important."
records.zh: “投给那个贪腐的家伙，这很重要！”

records.source: "Blaine, Blaine, James G. Blaine, The Continental Liar from the State of Maine!"
records.zh: “布莱恩，布莱恩，詹姆斯·G.·布莱恩，缅因州来的举国大骗子！”

records.source: "I like Ike!"
records.zh: “我喜欢艾克！”

records.source: "A house divided can not stand." - Abraham Lincoln
records.zh: “分裂之家，不能长存。”——亚伯拉罕·林肯

records.source: "Ask not what your country can do for you- ask what you can do for your country." - John Kennedy
records.zh: “不要问国家能为你做什么，要问你能为国家做什么。”——约翰·肯尼迪

records.source: "Give me six hours to chop down a tree and I will spend four sharpening the axe" - Abraham Lincoln
records.zh: “给我六小时砍一棵树，我会用四小时磨斧头。”——亚伯拉罕·林肯
